timezone.description: the host's IANA time zone name such as Etc/UTC

http_port.description: the native openHAB HTTP listener port on loopback (default 13602)

https_port.description: the native openHAB HTTPS listener port on loopback (default 13603)

uid.description: the positive non-root numeric user id of the thermite service account (default 9001)

gid.description: the positive non-root numeric group id of the thermite service account (default 9001)

gateway.description: HTTPS gateway listener port and bind addresses

listen.description: this host's own IP addresses the HTTPS gateway binds besides loopback

items.description: an IPv4 or IPv6 address of this host

metrics.description: Prometheus, Grafana and node_exporter host overrides

units.description: additional systemd unit names for node_exporter to report on

retention.description: how long Prometheus keeps samples, a duration such as 395d

retention_size.description: maximum disk Prometheus uses, a size such as 12GB

yoke_targets.description: optional external Yoke observer host:port endpoints for Prometheus to scrape

node_exporter_uid.description: positive numeric uid and gid for node_exporter's own account, distinct from uid and gid

exporter_port.description: thermite metrics exporter loopback listener port (default 13610)

guest_http.description: opt-in plain-HTTP Guest listener restricted to listed client networks

listen.description: this host's own IP addresses the Guest listener binds

items.description: an IPv4 or IPv6 address of this host

clients.description: client CIDR networks admitted by the Guest listener

items.description: an IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR network

names.description: lowercase DNS hostnames guests may type to reach the Guest listener

music.description: opt-in Music Assistant libraries and listener ports

libraries.description: music libraries mounted read-only into Music Assistant

port.description: Music Assistant loopback API listener port (default 13627)

stream_port.description: Music Assistant LAN audio stream listener port (default 13628)

server.description: the server hostname or IPv4 address

share.description: the SMB share name (and optional subdirectory), for cifs shares

export.description: the exported absolute directory path, for nfs shares

where.description: the local mount point below /mnt or /media

writable.description: whether the share is mounted read-write instead of read-only

version.description: optional quoted SMB or NFS protocol version such as 3.1.1 or 4.2
